name: My Handsome Bodyguard
overview: Lea is the daughter of one of the world's most renowned mafia bosses. She lives a life of privilege and luxury, with her bossy attitude, but soon her father dies in a tragic plane crash. After accepting the demise of her father, Lea takes over the mafia business. She is companied by her new bodyguard, Ryan. Under Ryan's urge, Lea announces to call off her engagement with Michael. Lea's insult made Michael leave her house in a rage, promising her dreadful revenge...
